image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), is perched on green grass. The bird displays a dark grey/black head and throat, an orange-rufous breast, and brownish-black wings with distinct white wing bars. The background consists of out-of-focus green grass blades.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is very slight softness where the bird's feet meet the grass. It is difficult to distinguish exactly where the toes end and the grass begins due to occlusion and slight blending, but no major structural fusion is evident.
